d:
Rahul Gandhi took a trip down memory lane at the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, with an amusing account of his parents' affection. He recalled how Sonia would sit on Rajiv Gandhi's lap during mealtimes, a sight he considered perfectly normal as a child. He also reflected on the family tragedies that shaped their lives. Watch Rahul Gandhi's candid and emotional revelations at the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love.
Produced & Edited By Kashish Dhawan
